Rows commented out with a `#` prefix (DESIGN 3.4), on a full replay (no stored snapshot, `now` 2026-09-08T10:00). In `primary` the `#team` row of 13 July that would have removed dave is ignored, so dave stays on the roster and keeps taking his turns; the `#shift` row of 24 August is ignored too, so that week is an uncovered span that the script fills again, as it would after deleting the row, here with alice again because she is lowest by order at that point; both rows are written back verbatim, type text included, sorted at their instant above the regenerated shift, so removing the `#` restores them. In `#Global` the `#set tolerance=7` row is a comment and `tolerance` stays 0 (`expected/status.txt` shows the rotation's value and `global 0` rows read). In `#Holidays` the `#2026-09-07` row is commented out, so only two holidays are read and no `bad date` stops the run. In `gcal.csv` the `#old` block is disabled down to the next preset row (its unknown `colour` setting raises no error) and the `#color` row of `team` is skipped, so the `Calendar (no calendar)` block lists only `team` and the plan has no errors.
